title: BIG3 Festival
description:
Oui. Sur le visuel, la liste est très longue. Pour une description d’événement, je te conseille de mettre les artistes principaux, puis les DJs séparément.
🌟 BIG3 FESTIVAL 2027 – HAMBURG 🌟
Get ready for 3 unforgettable days of dance, music and connection at BIG3 Festival 2027! 🔥
📅 19–21 February 2027
📍 Congress Center Hamburg, Germany
BIG3 brings together the international Bachata, Salsa, Kizomba and Brazilian Zouk communities under one roof, with workshops, shows, social dancing, parties and an incredible international line-up. (Where to dance Salsa)
💃 INTERNATIONAL ARTISTS

🎧 DJs:
DJ Dmitri • DJ Rumbero • DJ Michelle • DJ Yasser • DJ Miguel • DJ Miss Maya • DJ Pablo G • DJ Fran • DJ Traybeatz • DJ Shark • DJ Morelasoul • DJ Wicca Mix • DJ Firenz
The festival features multiple dance floors, international workshops, social dancing, shows and competitions throughout the weekend. (FindBachata)
